text: well and so, let me give you my logic here because i did some math, i have been making my pieces in the 1/16th tile scale, knowing that a car lane is ~3 tiles, and so that means if i author the bridge pieces and such at this scale, i know how many nudges it takes to properly scale it to size, being, the entire model would then take 48 to regain its width and depth; the main reason for this was just that the camera would be a real pain in the ass to try and handle a bridge at scale up front
resolution: Made bridge path sizing respect the miniature authoring workflow. Rise and XYZ points use the editor's ruled u scale (16 u per tile), the source X/Z spans are measured from the live edited mesh, and the dialog includes a non-mutating x1/x16/x48 world-size readout so a bridge can stay camera-friendly until its final uniform scale.
